import json, os, tempfile, time, contextlib, sys, importlib
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
import do_again.service.liveness as liveness

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    root=Path(td)
    test_repo=root/"repo"; test_repo.mkdir()
    state=root/"state"; state.mkdir()
    control=root/"control"; control.mkdir()
    receipts=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"; receipts.mkdir(parents=True)

    receipt=receipts/"r1.json"
    receipt.write_text('{"request_id":"r1"}',encoding="utf-8")
    old=time.time()-3600
    os.utime(receipt,(old,old))
    (test_repo/"do-again.toml").write_text(
        "[do_again]\ncontinuous = true\nidle_seconds = 60\nrecovery_seconds = 60\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    target=Mock()
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"ensure_browser_running",return_value={"port":9223}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"project_record",return_value={"chat_url":"https://chatgpt.com/c/project"}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_find_chatgpt_target",return_value=target))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_assistant_snapshot",return_value={"busy":False}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_context_limit_warning",return_value=""))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_page_contains",return_value=False))
        send=stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"send_message"))
        send.side_effect=TimeoutError("injected send outcome unknown")

        try:
            liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
        except TimeoutError:
            pass
        else:
            raise SystemExit("initial transport failure did not surface")
        first=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())
        if first.get("idle_resume_phase")!="uncertain" or send.call_count!=1:
            raise SystemExit(f"initial uncertain state invalid: {first}, calls={send.call_count}")

    # Simulate process/module restart: reload module, then patch a fresh browser seam.
    liveness=importlib.reload(liveness)
    target2=Mock()
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"ensure_browser_running",return_value={"port":9223}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"project_record",return_value={"chat_url":"https://chatgpt.com/c/project"}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_find_chatgpt_target",return_value=target2))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_assistant_snapshot",return_value={"busy":False}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_context_limit_warning",return_value=""))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_page_contains",return_value=False))
        send2=stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"send_message"))

        second=liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
        after_restart=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())

        # Force bounded deadline past due and check again after the simulated restart.
        after_restart["idle_resume_at"]=time.time()-120
        (state/"liveness.json").write_text(json.dumps(after_restart),encoding="utf-8")
        third=liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
        final=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())

    print(json.dumps({
      "first":first,
      "after_restart_state":second,
      "after_restart":after_restart,
      "final_state":third,
      "final":final,
      "post_restart_send_calls":send2.call_count,
    },indent=2,sort_keys=True))

    if second!="idle_delivery_uncertain":
        raise SystemExit(f"restart forgot uncertain handoff: {second}")
    if send2.call_count!=0:
        raise SystemExit(f"restart replayed continuation send: {send2.call_count}")
    if third!="stalled_idle_handoff":
        raise SystemExit(f"restart path failed bounded escalation: {third}")
    if send2.call_count!=0:
        raise SystemExit(f"escalation replayed send after restart: {send2.call_count}")
    if final.get("idle_resume_phase")!="uncertain":
        raise SystemExit(f"uncertain marker lost after restart: {final}")
    if final.get("idle_resume_marker")!=first.get("idle_resume_marker"):
        raise SystemExit("restart changed durable idempotency marker")

print("RESTART_UNCERTAIN_HANDOFF_NO_REPLAY_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
